findings.section: Train on other years, test on one year
findings.claim: Trained on other years and tested on a held-out year, the step-1 boosting AUC in bullet is 0.908 against 0.944 with game-grouped folds.
findings.metric: boosting AUC on pooled held-out predictions, each test year (>= 100 games) predicted by a model trained on the other years, all features
findings.n: 3287 games (held-out predictions pooled over test years 2022-2025)
findings.caveat: The gap to the game-grouped AUC is how much of the fingerprint is year-specific (rating level, time-control mix, repertoire of the time); it is large in blitz and rapid. The 2022 test year is the weakest in every class.
